evidence.pali: ‘‘‘Pītipaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘pītipaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘sukhapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘sukhapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati.
evidence.chinese_simplified: “学：‘我将觉知喜而出息’；学：‘我将觉知喜而入息’。学：‘我将觉知乐而出息’；学：‘我将觉知乐而入息’。学：‘我将觉知心行而出息’；学：‘我将觉知心行而入息’。学：‘我将平静心行而出息’；学：‘我将平静心行而入息’。”
evidence.english: He trains thus: ‘Experiencing rapture, I will breathe out.’ He trains thus: ‘Experiencing rapture, I will breathe in.’ He trains thus: ‘Experiencing pleasure, I will breathe out.’ He trains thus: ‘Experiencing pleasure, I will breathe in.’ He trains thus: ‘Experiencing the mental formation, I will breathe out.’ He trains thus: ‘Experiencing the mental formation, I will breathe in.’ He trains thus: ‘Calming the mental formation, I will breathe out.’ He trains thus: ‘Calming the mental formation, I will breathe in.’

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: Ettha pana yadetaṃ ‘sattarasamassa bhavaṅgacittassa uppādakkhaṇeyeva nirujjhatī’tiādinā nayena ‘ekassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe uppannaṃ rūpaṃ aññassa uppādakkhaṇe nirujjhatī’ti aṭṭhakathāyaṃ āgatattā vuttaṃ, taṃ ‘‘yassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati, tassa cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhatī’’ti? ‘‘Āmantā’’ti (yama. 2.saṅkhārayamaka.79) imāya pāḷiyā virujjhati. Kathaṃ? Kāyasaṅkhāro hi cittasamuṭṭhāno assāsapassāsavāto. Cittasamuṭṭhānarūpañca cittassa uppādakkhaṇe uppajjitvā yāva aññāni soḷasa cittāni uppajjanti tāva tiṭṭhati. Tesaṃ soḷasannaṃ sabbapacchimena saddhiṃ nirujjhati. Iti yena cittena saddhiṃ uppajjati, tato paṭṭhāya sattarasamena saddhiṃ nirujjhati; na kassaci cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vā ṭhitikkhaṇe vā nirujjhati, nāpi ṭhitikkhaṇe vā bhaṅgakkhaṇe vā uppajjati. Esā cittasamuṭṭhānarūpassa dhammatāti niyamato cittasaṅkhārena saddhiṃ ekakkhaṇe nirujjhanato ‘‘āmantā’’ti vuttaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 此处所言‘于第十七有分心生起刹那即灭’等，是依据义注(aṭṭhakathā)中‘于一心生起刹那所生之色，于另一心生起刹那灭去’的说法。此论与经中的“若身行(kāyasaṅkhāra)灭，心行(cittasaṅkhāra)亦灭耶？”“诚然(Āmantā)”之文句相抵触。为何如此？身行，即是心所生之入出息风。心所生色法(cittasamuṭṭhānarūpa)于心生起刹那生起，并持续至另外十六心生起为止。它与此十六心中的最末者同时坏灭。因此，它与哪个心同时生起，就从那个心算起，与第十七个心同时坏灭。它并非在任何一心的生起刹那或住刹那坏灭，亦非在住刹那或灭刹那生起。此乃心所生色法之法性。由于它必定与心行于同一刹那坏灭，故（经中）回答‘诚然’。
entries.english: Here, however, what is stated in the commentary, in the manner of 'it ceases precisely at the arising moment of the seventeenth life-continuum consciousness,' and 'the material form arisen at the arising moment of one consciousness ceases at the arising moment of another,' contradicts this Pāli passage: 'When the bodily formation ceases, does the mental formation cease?' 'Yes.' (Yamaka 2, Saṅkhārayamaka, 79). How so? For the bodily formation is the in-and-out breath, which is mind-originated. And mind-originated material form arises at the arising moment of a consciousness and persists until sixteen other consciousnesses have arisen. It ceases together with the very last of those sixteen. Thus, it arises together with a particular consciousness and ceases together with the seventeenth from that starting point. It does not cease at the arising or presence moment of any consciousness, nor does it arise at the presence or dissolution moment. This is the nature of mind-originated material form; because, as a rule, it ceases in a single moment together with the mental formation, 'Yes' is said.

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: Saṅkhatamabhisaṅkharontīti saṅkhārā. Apica avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārasaddena āgatasaṅkhārā cāti duvidhā saṅkhārā. Tattha puññāpuññāneñjābhisaṅkhārā tayo, kāyavacīcittasaṅkhārā tayoti ime cha avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā . Te sabbepi lokiyakusalākusalacetanāmattameva honti.
entries.chinese_simplified: 造作有为法，故名为“行”。此外，行有二种：以无明为缘之行，以及以“行”之名而来的行。其中，福行、非福行、不动行此三者，以及身行、语行、心行此三者，此六种是以无明为缘之行。彼等皆仅是世间的善、不善思。
entries.english: They construct the conditioned—hence they are formations. Moreover, formations are of two kinds: those that are conditioned by ignorance, and those that are referred to by the word ‘formations.’ Among them, the three—meritorious, demeritorious, and imperturbable formations—and the three—bodily, verbal, and mental formations—these six are formations conditioned by ignorance. All of them are merely worldly wholesome and unwholesome volitions.

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: Kāmūpasevanādīsu ca savipākesu ādīnavaṃ apassanto sukhasaññāya ceva kilesābhibhūtatāya ca dvārattayappavattampi apuññābhisaṅkhāraṃ ārabhati bālo viya gūthakīḷanaṃ, maritukāmo viya ca visakhādanaṃ. Āruppavipākesu cāpi saṅkhāravipariṇāmadukkhataṃ anavabujjhamāno sassatādivipallāsena cittasaṅkhārabhūtaṃ āneñjābhisaṅkhāraṃ ārabhati disāmūḷho viya pisācanagarābhimukhamaggagamanaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 又，不见受用欲乐等有果报之事中的过患，且因乐想及为烦恼所制伏，愚者便发起经由三门转起的非福行，犹如小儿戏粪，又如求死者食毒。又，不悟解无色界果报中诸行变坏之苦，且因常见等颠倒，便发起属于心行的不动行，犹如迷途者走向罗刹之城。
entries.english: Not seeing the danger in sensual indulgence and so forth, and in their results, the fool, overcome by the perception of happiness and by the defilements, initiates unwholesome volitional formations that operate through the three doors—like a child playing with excrement or one wishing to die consuming poison. And also, not comprehending the suffering of the changing nature of formations in the results of the formless attainments, one initiates the imperturbable volitional formation, which is a mental formation, due to the distortion of eternalism and so forth—like a bewildered person heading toward a city of demons.

entries.pali: Sveva dvīsu bhavesū ti ettha ekūnatiṃsacetanābhedampi cittasaṅkhāraṃ cittasaṅkhārabhāvena ekattaṃ upanetvā ‘‘svevā’’ ti vuttaṃ. Tadekadeso pana kāmāvacaracittasaṅkhārova terasannaṃ navannañca paccayo daṭṭhabbo. Ekadesapaccayabhāvena hi samudāyo vuttoti.
entries.chinese_simplified: ‘即于二有中’，此处是将二十九种思(cetanā)的差别，以其同为心行(cittasaṅkhāra)的性质而归为一体，因此说‘即’。然而，其中的一部分，即欲界的心行，应被视为是十三种和九种(异熟)的缘。这是因为以部分作为缘的性质，而说其为总体。
entries.english: Herein, regarding 'in the two existences only,' the mental formation, which is the twenty-nine kinds of volition, having been brought to oneness by way of being a mental formation, is referred to as 'that very one.' However, a portion of it, namely the sense-sphere mental formation alone, should be seen as the condition for the thirteen and the nine. For the aggregate is spoken of by way of being a partial condition.

entries.pali: ‘‘Ekūnatiṃsacetanābhedampī’’ ti iminā uddhaccacetanāyapi pavattivipākadāyitaṃ anujānāti, aṭṭhakathāadhippāyavasena vā evamāha. Pañcadasannaṃ ahetukavipākaviññāṇānaṃ pañcaṭṭhānāni dve apanetvā avasesānaṃ terasannaṃ . Dve dve cakkhusotasampaṭicchanaviññāṇāni, tīṇi santīraṇānīti navannaṃ . Ekadesapaccayabhāvenā ti ekadesassa vīsaticetanābhedassa kāmāvacaracittasaṅkhārassa paccayabhāvena ekūnatiṃsacetanābhedo samudāyo vutto. Svevā ti avayavagatenāpi visesena samudāyo voharīyati yathā ‘‘alaṅkato rājakumāro’’ti.
entries.chinese_simplified: 通过‘亦有二十九思之差别’，此句亦认可掉举思(uddhaccacetanā)能给予流转果报，或此说是依义注之意。于十五无因果报识中，于五处除去二者，余有十三。二眼识、二耳识、二领受识(sampaṭicchanaviññāṇa)、三推度识(santīraṇa)，此为九种。‘以部分为缘性’，是指以欲界心行(kāmāvacaracittasaṅkhāra)此二十思差别之一部分为缘，而说为二十九思差别之集合。此即是说，亦可以部分之特性称呼全体，犹如说‘已装饰之王子’。
entries.english: By ‘even the division of twenty-nine volitions,’ he allows that even the volition associated with restlessness gives a resultant in the course of existence, or he speaks thus according to the intention of the Commentary. For the fifteen rootless resultant consciousnesses, having removed two from the five occasions, it is a condition for the remaining thirteen. For the nine: two each of eye- and ear-receiving-consciousnesses, and three investigating consciousnesses. By ‘by way of being a condition in part’ is meant that the aggregate, the division of twenty-nine volitions, is spoken of because of the conditionality of one part, that is, the sense-sphere mental formation which is the division of twenty volitions. In the same way, an aggregate is designated by a particular that pertains to a part, just as it is said, ‘the prince is adorned.’

entries.pali: 37 . Suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne ti tesaṃ paṭhamato avitakkaavicārato dutiye savitakkasavicārepi bhavanikantiāvajjane vattamāne ubhayaṃ nuppajjitthāti dassentena tato purimacittakkhaṇesupi nuppajjitthāti dassitameva hoti. Yathā pana cittasaṅkhārassa ādidassanatthaṃ ‘‘suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantāna’’nti vuttaṃ, evaṃ vacīsaṅkhārassa ādidassanatthaṃ ‘‘dutiye citte vattamāne’’ti vuttanti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 37. ‘净居天众在第二个心生起时’，这是为了显示：对于他们，从最初（结生心）的无寻无伺，到第二个有寻有伺、于有爱转向(bhavanikantiāvajjana)进行时，二者（身行和语行）皆不生起。如此，也就显示了在之前的诸心刹那中，它们也未曾生起。正如为了显示心行的开端而说‘当往生净居天时’，应知，同样地，为了显示语行的开端而说‘在第二个心生起时’。
entries.english: 37. When it is said, 'For the Suddhāvāsa beings, when the second consciousness is occurring': by showing that for them—whose first consciousness is without initial and sustained thought, and whose second, the advertence of delight in existence, is with initial and sustained thought—neither bodily nor verbal formation arose, it is thereby shown that they did not arise in the preceding moments of consciousness either. Just as 'for those being reborn in the Suddhāvāsa' is stated to show the beginning of mental formation, so 'when the second consciousness is occurring' is stated to show the beginning of verbal formation; this should be understood.

entries.pali: 37 . Āvajjanato pubbe pavattaṃ sabbaṃ cittaṃ paṭisandhicittena samānagatikattā ekaṃ katvā vuttaṃ ‘‘paṭhamato’’ ti. Tenāha ‘‘avitakkaavicārato’’ tiādi. Cittasaṅkhārassa ādidassanattha nti suddhāvāse cittasaṅkhārassa ādidassanatthaṃ. Tathā ‘‘vacīsaṅkhārassa ādidassanattha’’ nti etthāpi.
entries.chinese_simplified: 37. 因转向(āvajjana)之前生起的一切心，与结生心(paṭisandhicitta)属于同类，故合说为“最初”(paṭhamato)。因此他说：“无寻无伺”(avitakkaavicāra)等。是为了显示心行(cittasaṅkhāra)的开端，即在净居天(suddhāvāsa)显示心行的开端。同样，“为了显示语行(vacīsaṅkhāra)的开端”此处亦然。
entries.english: 37. All the consciousness that has occurred before adverting is spoken of as one with the rebirth-linking consciousness because they have the same destination; thus it is said, 'from the first.' Therefore he says, 'from what is without initial thought and sustained thought,' and so on. 'To show the beginning of the mental formation' means to show the beginning of the mental formation in the Pure Abodes. Similarly here too, 'to show the beginning of the verbal formation.'

entries.work_title: 阿毗达摩入门-名色分别 Abhidhammāvatāro-Nāmarūpaparicchedo
entries.pali: Vuttā kāyavacīcittasaṅkhārāti mahesinā; Saṅkhārā ti vibhattevamekūnatiṃsa cetanā.
entries.chinese_simplified: 被大仙说为身行、语行、心行。如是，此二十九种思被分别为‘行’。
entries.english: are called the bodily, verbal, and mental formations by the Great Seer. Thus are the formations analyzed as twenty-nine volitions.

entries.work_title: 阿毗达摩入门-名色分别 Abhidhammāvatāro-Nāmarūpaparicchedo
entries.pali: Vedanāsaññāsaṅkhāte, cittasaṅkhārake tathā; Pītādipaṭisaṃvedī, sikkhatīti pavuccati.
entries.chinese_simplified: 于受与想所成之心行中，感受喜等，故说为‘彼学’。
entries.english: One who experiences joy and so on, with regard to what are termed feeling and perception, and likewise mental formations, is said to be 'one who trains'.
